examples.description: Split a scene at 7.5 seconds on the timeline

description: Cut a scene or a timeline clip in two at a timeline millisecond. The left half keeps the id; the right half is new and is returned. Both halves must keep at least 100ms of footage or the split refuses. Transitions stay on the outer edges - the new seam is a hard cut.

at_ms.description: TIMELINE position of the cut, not an offset into the element.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

target_id.description: A scene id or a timeline clip id.
